# Toolshed

A tool-lending library for a neighbourhood: members borrow tools, pay a refundable deposit, and
bring them back. The specification is the pack under `docs/`; start at
[the index](docs/prd/index.md). Lending starts at LND-F-001.

PRDR-280's parity fixture: a pack in the shapes of the ksarjs pack that `check_pack.py` checked,
with its own content. See [docs/README.md](docs/README.md).
